department: Biochemistry, Cellular and Molecular Biology (BCMB) PhD, School of Medicine

deadline.value: The application window is September 8 to December 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: The application for the BCMB program is open from 9/8/2026 to 12/1/2026.

app_fee.value: School of Medicine fee is USD 125 and covers up to four programs.
app_fee.quote: An application fee of $125 is required and must be submitted using a credit card.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are for US citizens and permanent residents meeting School of Medicine criteria.
fee_waiver.quote: U.S. citizens and U.S. permanent residents who meet the School of Medicine’s published eligibility requirements may be eligible for an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required and not considered; do not submit them.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required and will not be considered in the admissions process for BCMB.

toefl_min.value: School of Medicine page requires a test but gives no minimum score.

ielts_min.value: School of Medicine page requires a test but gives no minimum score.

english_waiver.value: The waiver covers degrees from the US or from a country whose official language is English; the page does not say whether India counts.

funding.value: School of Medicine PhD students receive guaranteed financial support (minimum USD 52,000 in 2026-27) with tuition covered.
funding.quote: JHU School of Medicine PhD students receive guaranteed financial support

supervisor.value: The page does not mention a supervisor before admission.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

entry_route.value: The pages checked do not state the entry route.

notes: Other School of Medicine PhDs (Pharmacology, Cellular and Molecular Medicine, Immunology, Human Genetics, Pathobiology) were not researched separately.
